description_expanded: Must be at least 25 years of age to rent this property. Gulf Place Town Center East #411 on 30a! Walk to Beach and Gulf Place amenities Brought to you by Beach Blue Properties, #411 is located right in the heart of Gulf Place on 30A with lovely 4th floor views of the sugar white beach from the balcony. Gulf Place is a trendy, picturesque town on the beaches of 30A with eclectic boutiques, art galleries, family owned stores, bistros, a Pilates studio, pharmacy, and outdoor green space for entertainment. Our vacation rental offers exclusive access to all three Gulf Place pools and hot tubs, picturesque walking trails and private beach access. And for the sports enthusiast in the group, enjoy tennis and pickle ball courts available on a first-come, first-served basis! Plan to visit the nearby towns of Seaside, Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Watersound, and Rosemary. For a day trip adventure, charter a fishing boat, enjoy boutique shopping at the Destin Commons, outlet shopping at the Silver Sands Premium Outlets, or the Big Kahunas Water Park in Destin. This 4th floor, corner unit one bedroom studio condo is boldly designed in hip “South Beach” decor with lively colors and stylish imported furnishings. The low profile and stylish furniture is low to the ground so that you can have the best views of the beach! The living area offers comfortable seating, including a new futon a large flat panel Smart TV (no cable), complimentary WIFI, and access to a private balcony and seating through French doors. The balcony features outdoor seating and awesome views of the beach and bustling Gulf Place. There is a fully stocked kitchen with everything needed to prepare and serve meals, snacks and drinks, which includes a fridge, sink, and two eye stove burner. With a queen size bed and sleeper futon that fold out to a full size bed, there is plenty of room for up to four guests. The guest bathroom features a brand new tiled shower and fully remodeled bathroom. There is a laundry room on the 2nd floor for guests to use. With a brand new AC unit, tankless hot water heater, and queen mattress, this unit will be the perfect getaway! Town Center East 411 is perfect for couples looking for a romantic escape or a small family trip to the beach. Treat yourself to a relaxing and memorable vacation at “Cabana 411”. CANCELLATION: Reservations that are cancelled more than 30 days prior to the arrival date receive a full refund. Reservations cancelled 14-29 days prior to arrival receive a refund of 50% of the amount paid. Reservations cancelled within 14 days of arrival receive no refund unless the guest purchased travel insurance. Guests are required to complete a rental agreement by electronic signature within 3 days of booking. NOTE: The total reservation cost includes the nightly rate, clean fee, damage waiver, transportation fee (for select properties), processing fee and tax. By requesting a quote for this property, you agree to be added to our email subscription list.
